name: CNNVD (China National Vulnerability Database)
description: Operated by the Chinese Ministry of Public Security. Assigns vulnerability levels and official IDs recognized by Chinese government agencies and critical infrastructure operators.

peerReview.processDescription: Reviews include technical validation and impact assessment aligned with Chinese national standards. Assigns vulnerability levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low) using methodology based on CVSS principles.

attribution.attributionNotes: Official vulnerability IDs and severity ratings recognized by Chinese government agencies.

povsAlignment.description: Chinese national vulnerability database with government-recognized IDs and severity ratings.
